name: cheese-draft
prompt: Locked-off static camera, studio food commercial, macro. The two slices of melted cheese on the burger slowly soften and sag, then thick glossy golden strands of molten cheese ooze over the edge and drip down in front of the burger, stretching longer and longer, heavy and viscous, until the longest strands hang all the way down to the bottom of the frame. The burger, bun and patties stay exactly the same and do not move. The plain cream background stays perfectly unchanged and empty. Smooth, slow, photorealistic.
